'''Rylothian slave collars''' were [[Shock collar/Legends|slaving collars]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. They were in use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] period, though they had been outlawed by [[Republic Law 44-12]].
